baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Automated guided vehicle for electrode rolls. A self-navigating vehicle with a lifting mechanism that raises a feeder assembly to load anode and cathode rolls in a battery plant. The Automated guided vehicle for electrode rolls is assembled in South Korea using components sourced from China and South Korea.

The lower frame assembly (chassis) with drive frame components and upper frame assembly with roller support and shear lifting mechanism are produced in China. The drive assembly, battery, casters and controllers are produced in South Korea. 

Final assembly in South Korea: install the drive assembly, battery, controllers, cameras, sensors and wiring, join the frames, fit the cover, load software, calibrate and test.

key_factors: Drive assembly, battery, controllers, and final integration/calibration
prediction.decisive_step: Final assembly, integration of Korean propulsion/control systems with Chinese frames, software loading, and calibration in South Korea
prediction.reasoning: While the structural lower and upper frames with lifting mechanisms are made in China (compare N334276), an Automated Guided Vehicle's essential character as a self-navigating vehicle is equally or more defined by its propulsion, power, and autonomous navigation systems. Because the drive assembly, battery, and controllers are produced in South Korea, and complex final integration, sensor installation, software loading, and calibration occur there, the components undergo a substantial transformation in South Korea.

plans.description: Move the chassis and frame and the working frames to South Korea
plans.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Automated guided vehicle for electrode rolls. A self-navigating vehicle with a lifting mechanism that raises a feeder assembly to load anode and cathode rolls in a battery plant. The Automated guided vehicle for electrode rolls is assembled in South Korea using components sourced from South Korea.

The lower frame assembly (chassis) with drive frame components, upper frame assembly with roller support and shear lifting mechanism and drive assembly, battery, casters and controllers are produced in South Korea. 

In South Korea, the lower frame assembly (chassis) with drive frame components will be produced in-house: cut, weld and polish metal plates into the chassis and fit the drive frame components.

In South Korea, the upper frame assembly with roller support and shear lifting mechanism will be produced in-house: weld tubing, sheets and plates into the upper frame and mount the lifting and roller support mechanisms.

Final assembly in South Korea: install the drive assembly, battery, controllers, cameras, sensors and wiring, join the frames, fit the cover, load software, calibrate and test.

key_factors: Lower and upper frame assemblies, drive assembly, and controllers
prediction.decisive_step: Fabrication of structural frames, subassemblies, and final assembly in South Korea
prediction.reasoning: All major components—including the lower chassis, upper frame with lifting mechanism, drive assembly, battery, and controllers—are sourced and fabricated from raw metal plates and tubing in South Korea. Furthermore, all subassembly and final assembly operations, including software loading and calibration, occur entirely in South Korea. Consistent with N334276 and N333646, where the fabrication of major structural subassemblies and final assembly confer origin, the vehicle is wholly produced and substantially transformed in South Korea.

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, CBP held origin was China because the lower frame assembly (chassis) and upper frame assembly with lifting mechanism were produced in China, while final assembly and the remaining components were in South Korea. In Variant B, the production of both the lower frame assembly (cutting, welding, polishing plates) and upper frame assembly (welding tubing, sheets, and plates) moves to South Korea, so all components and assembly are in South Korea. Consistent with N334276 (scissor lifts) and N333646 (hydraulic jacks), where fabricating and welding the chassis/frame and lifting subassemblies determines origin, origin changes to South Korea.
